server.title: Blink Camera

environmentVariables.description: Blink account email address.
environmentVariables.name: BLINK_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Blink account password.
environmentVariables.name: BLINK_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the 2FA code, when the account has verification enabled. The code is read from the file, never from the command line.
environmentVariables.name: BLINK_2FA_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Which camera to drive, when the account has more than one.
environmentVariables.name: BLINK_CAMERA_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Where to cache the login token. Defaults to ~/.blink-mcp/state.json.
environmentVariables.name: BLINK_STATE_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the ffmpeg binary, if it is not on PATH.
environmentVariables.name: BLINK_FFMPEG

server.name: io.github.AbhijatSaxena/uvc-ptz-camera-mcp
server.description: Control a USB (UVC) pan/tilt/zoom camera, with every move confirmed from the picture.
server.title: UVC PTZ Camera

environmentVariables.description: Where to store what has been learned about each camera. Defaults to ~/.uvc-ptz-camera-mcp. Holds angles, never credentials.
environmentVariables.name: UVC_PTZ_STATE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Path to an image to use as the simulator's panorama instead of the synthesised one.
environmentVariables.name: UVC_PTZ_SIM_SOURCE
